reviews.conclusion: Repeated portal travel, settings changes, a narrow game view, and same-world death/respawn occur. Visible pause/settings screens total 3.75-5.25 s, while the narrow view lasts 2.75-3.25 s with unknown pause state. The -5.8333 s total is not exactly resolved. Death followed by returning to the placed bed and collecting items is not treated as a new attempt or as automatically paused time.

Nether-to-stronghold loading and three settings visits are visible. Menu duration totals 3.75-5.25 s, compatible with the -4.4333 s deficit; the dimension-loading sample is separate. Inventory, debug screen and profiler overlays are not counted as pause screens.

A long bastion sequence contains pause/options at source 158.92-159.67 s and another brief pause at 209.92-210.17 s. Combined menu time is approximately 1.0-2.0 s, compatible with the -1.3417 s deficit. The resource pack changes item and menu labels, but that visual presentation is not itself evidence of cheating.

A stronghold death/respawn is followed by End entry and settings/video menus at proxy 12.75-14 s. The menu bounds of 1.25-1.75 s contain the 1.333 s deficit. The earlier death screen is recorded separately and not assumed to stop the GUI clock.

The bracket crosses run completion. The screen turns black for approximately 1.0-1.5 s, compatible with -1.0833 s, then briefly shows the End scene again before overworld return. Frozen visible RTA 08:20.832 matches retained official proof metadata. IGT differs from official corrected IGT; the proof comment explicitly notes a retime from 08:02.945 to 08:04.797. No active-run edit is established.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
